name: Seoyeon
purpose: Get to SFO cheaply for Thanksgiving travel and meet other students doing the same; prefers Korean.

language.notes: Reads English slowly and second-guesses buttons. Would much rather use Korean UI and will look for a language setting.

backstory: I'm only here for one semester and I'm flying out of SFO the day before Thanksgiving. An Uber alone is so expensive. In Korea I'd post in the Everytime board, but I don't know what American students use. My English is OK for class but app menus confuse me sometimes, so I go slowly.
quitsWhen: I can't understand what a button will do
It asks me to post my phone number or address publicly
No Korean option and too much text
voice: Polite, careful, thinks in Korean (어... 이건 뭐지? 영어가 너무 많아). Short English phrases.
